title: Zesty Crunchy Okinawan Rice Onigiri
description: A zesty, crunchy Okinawan onigiri packed with fermented shio‑koji, capers and a tangy lemon‑sesame glaze, all cooked in a single paella pan for a quick, jain‑friendly dinner.
instructions: Rinse the rice until water runs clear, then soak for 10 minutes.
Heat the paella pan over medium heat and add the rice and water, bringing to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and let the rice steam for 18 minutes until tender.
While rice cooks, combine shio‑koji, capers, sesame seeds, rice vinegar, sea salt, lemon zest, soy sauce, and lemon juice in a bowl.
Once the rice is done, fluff it with a fork and fold in the flavor mixture, stirring gently until evenly coated.
Remove the pan from heat and let the rice rest for 5 minutes, then transfer the mixture to a shallow dish to cool slightly.
Scoop portions of rice and shape each into triangular onigiri, pressing firmly to set.
Serve immediately, optionally garnishing with extra toasted sesame seeds.
